text: Over the course of the pandemic the importance of delivery options has become highlighted. Urban delivery for the courier industry is becoming more difficult due to limited commercial vehicle parking, inadequate loading facilities, available capacity to meet growing demand and road congestion. This has led to an increase in delivery times, operational costs and greenhouse gas emissions from delivery vehicles, Addressing many of these issues requires new and innovative models and methods in last-mile delivery. The City can play a significant role in eliminating many of the regulatory barriers that prevent industry from pursuing these new and sustainable delivery models which could contribute positively towards many of the City's own corporate plans and goals.
